venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.weather: Mid 80s, cloudy, dropping to the 60s overnight
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Thursday 10/8 (MOD MKZ // JK).** Net sales $1,300 vs target $1,807 (-28.1%). Food $203. 36 guests, $36.11 check avg. Comps $16.50 (Industry Love $6.50, Bingo $10). Mellow start; little flow until ~6pm, steady quiet for hours, then a pop around 10pm as Intuit coworkers celebrating a birthday came in. Raven's first day training as a bartender (3–8:45pm). Opener cut just before 7:30pm; bar back handled prep. Last call smooth. Kitchen: Sysco order placed for tomorrow, stay on top of prep. Favorite moment: Joe from Intuit popping in with coworkers.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.weather: Really nice, lots of good foot traffic in the area
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Thursday 10/8 (MOD & Chef KK/KE/MD & DM).** Net sales $2,229 vs target $3,512 (-36.5%). Food $126. ~73 guests, $30.53 check avg. Comps $20.85 / 0.94% (Neuhoff employee, F&F). Slow start (~$240 by 7pm) but picked up 8–11pm for a couple grand: larger groups, dates, friends, industry. Service flow on point; team hit the floor for drink deliveries. Shoutout to Sara for carrying menus and giving guests a first touch. Kitchen: lower food sales for the volume, good remarks on everything ordered. Low: Nacho Cheese.

venues.narrative: **DVR — Thursday 10/8 (AM MOD Maggie S & Chef Josh; PM MOD Evan F & Chef Lucas).** Net sales incl. events $23,304.47 vs target $10,774 (+116.3%). DC/AM $1,313.63, D&C PM $8,192.20, base net $9,510.47; net event sales $13,794. Food incl. events $12,445.90. 265 guests (Tock). Comps $394.17 (~4.14%). Lobby chill but popped ~9:45 to close; events blew past target. Note: 10/8 DCAM report was flagged missing in the DC/AM notes. Ayu out; Fiellah came in on her day off.

venues.narrative: **EV — Thursday 10/8 (MOD & Chef: Everyone).** Net sales $5,976 vs target $5,664 (+5.5%). Food $639, beverage $5,337. 191 guests (SevenRooms), $31 check avg. Comps $237.68 / 4.0% (lots of past-worker love). Steady evening training Maia on the floor, rare waitlist moments, many first-timers and old friends. Top sellers: Shinebox, Paper Wasp, Cloudwalk. Door: solid walk-ins, small waitlist for 3s/4s ~8pm; a cancelled Timeleft reso still drew sporadic arrivals (heads-up to hosts). Menu count 16; breakage 1 DOF.

Comps $166.08 (FF 9.90, member/investor 43.18, rang wrong item 48, DNL 18, gift 35). No-show revenue $30. Gradual build, pop ~6:30, room full until midnight. Investor John Taylor and member Kevin in; Grace Ramirez with the Bacardi crew, then Patrón reps. Teleia's 3rd server training day; Sasha in for bar training. Garbage disposal sink out of order held up dish; plumber scheduled tomorrow 1–5pm. Maintenance: garbage disposal, curtain, glass rinser.

venues.weather: Breezy and cool morning with some clouds
venues.narrative: **MG — Thursday 10/8 (AM Sam & Lex; PM James & Marcus).** Net sales $9,144 vs target $6,800 (+34.5%). AM bar $917, Sun Club $243, Hot Eye $1,722; food $2,457. 170 guests (OpenTable: 24 AM + 146 PM). Comps $260. Mellow brunch with food tours; steady evening with many big groups (9-top, 6-top, late 7-top walk-in). Hot Eye slow until ~9:45 then full by 10 with overflow; Hot Eye's 1-year anniversary. Kitchen: low on toffee cake. Maintenance: downstairs smell the worst it has been, dissipated through the night.
